agent_conversations.description: Actor-owned corporate agent conversation with capability-specific validated context and a bounded execution lease.
agent_conversations.lifecycle: Local history persists until the owner explicitly deletes the conversation. Conversation deletion cascades to turns and contexts. No automatic expiry is implemented; shared deployment requires an owner-defined retention/backups/provider policy before rollout. No vector, export or replica copies are created by the application.

owner.description: Authenticated principal id or explicit loopback developer identity.

title.description: Owner-editable bounded title, initially derived from the first question; never model instructions.

version.description: Monotonically allocated turn sequence; advanced under a row lock.

contexts.description: Versioned capability contexts keyed by capability id. Sales version 2 stores structured conversation state: the last executed analysis plan and query filters, an unanswered request with its known slots and awaited information, and a bounded transcript of sales questions with application-authored clarifications or filter-only answer descriptions, never financial figures or result prose. The _agent entry records the last capability and the capability awaiting an answer. No secret credentials.

active_turn_id.description: Current execution lease holder; absence means no active execution.
active_turn_id.nullMeaning: Absent in the lifecycle states described in the field meaning.

lease_until.description: Database-clock lease expiry, 120 seconds after acceptance; absent when inactive.
lease_until.nullMeaning: Absent in the lifecycle states described in the field meaning.

updated_at.description: Database-clock last turn or organization change; list ordering, not an audit trail.

title_manual.description: Owner explicitly named this conversation; automatic first-turn naming must not replace it.

pinned.description: Owner favorite retained across archive/restore; archived favorites are excluded from the active pinned list.

archived.description: Hidden from active history without deleting turns or context. Restore before accepting new turns.

objects.agent_conversations_lease_check: Lease holder and expiry exist together.
objects.agent_conversations_contexts_check: Capability context must be a JSON object.
objects.agent_conversations_history_idx: Owner-scoped active/archive and favorite-first keyset listing.

agent_turns.description: One user message and its execution lifecycle, real progress, and versioned assistant outcome. Failed/interrupted turns retain no fabricated answer.
agent_turns.lifecycle: Local history persists until the owner explicitly deletes the conversation. Conversation deletion cascades to turns and contexts. No automatic expiry is implemented; shared deployment requires an owner-defined retention/backups/provider policy before rollout. No vector, export or replica copies are created by the application.

conversation_id.description: Owning conversation; hard deletion cascades to all turns.

request_id.description: Client UUID for idempotent acceptance replay; same id with different message is a conflict.

state.description: running, completed, failed or interrupted. Interrupted work is not automatically retried.

question.description: Bounded confidential user message; never logged.

reply.description: Version 1 envelope containing application-authored reply and bounded result snapshot. Not current ERP truth and never sent back to OpenAI as financial data.
reply.nullMeaning: Absent in the lifecycle states described in the field meaning.

events.description: Bounded ordered real progress events with stage, localized display message and instant; not durable workflow/audit infrastructure.

capability_id.description: Executed capability for a completed business reply; absent for social/failure turns.
capability_id.nullMeaning: Absent in the lifecycle states described in the field meaning.

failure_code.description: Allowlisted public failure code; absent unless failed/interrupted. No exception text.
failure_code.nullMeaning: Absent in the lifecycle states described in the field meaning.

finished_at.description: Database-clock terminal outcome instant; absent while running.
finished_at.nullMeaning: Absent in the lifecycle states described in the field meaning.

objects.agent_turns_conversation_id_fkey: Conversation ownership/lifecycle referential integrity; cascade on hard deletion.
objects.agent_turns_outcome_check: Terminal reply/failure and timestamp agree with lifecycle state.
objects.agent_turns_conversation_request_key: One acceptance per client request id in a conversation.

agent_turn_traces.description: Optional content-level AI trace of one turn, written only when IA_MNS_AI_TRACE=content: model/prompt identifiers, timings and token counts, routing and interpretation decisions, structured conversation state before and after, and the executed query filters. Never result rows, response prose, credentials or provider payloads. Used to reproduce failures and derive evaluation candidates.
agent_turn_traces.lifecycle: Written in the same transaction as the turn outcome and deleted by cascade with its turn or conversation. The runtime role can only append and read. Content capture is refused in production until the shared-deployment retention and access policy (PH-09) approves it. No automatic expiry is implemented.

turn_id.description: Traced turn; one trace per turn, deleted with it.

conversation_id.description: Owning conversation of the traced turn, for conversation-scoped export and cascade deletion.

captured_at.description: Database-clock instant the trace was stored with the turn outcome.

trace.description: Version 1 trace object: allowlisted metadata plus confidential interpretation content, bounded to 256 KB with content omitted rather than truncated beyond it.

objects.agent_turn_traces_turn_id_fkey: Trace lifecycle follows its turn; cascade on deletion.
objects.agent_turn_traces_trace_check: Trace must be a JSON object.
